name: aglyn
description: Work in your Aglyn workspace: sites, content, contacts and CRM, orders, forms, bookings and media.

interface.longDescription:
Aglyn is an open-source website platform: design, ship, and run your entire web presence from one place. This plugin lets ChatGPT work in your Aglyn workspace for you, in plain words.

Sign in to Aglyn, pick the workspace, and choose what the assistant may do: View only, or View and make changes. Nothing is copied or pasted, and you can disconnect it at any time under Settings, API keys, Connected apps.

What it can do
- Sites: list your sites, create a site, and publish a site.
- Site content: read and edit datasets and their records, the content behind listings, service pages, menus and directories.
- Contacts and CRM: find, add, update and merge contacts; work with companies, deals, tasks, activities, leads and email templates; read pipelines.
- Form entries: read what visitors sent, mark entries read, and delete them.
- Orders and products: read orders and products, and mark an order shipped or delivered with its carrier and tracking number.
- Bookings: read bookings.
- Media: list your media and upload new files.
- Usage: see how much of your plan's allowance is used.

Limits
- It follows your plan and your permissions: each area works only where your workspace includes it.
- It cannot cancel or refund an order, move or cancel a booking, rename or delete a site, or change your team, plan or billing. Those stay with you in the Aglyn console.
- It needs the Manage API keys permission in your Aglyn workspace, which owners and admins have.

Who filled in the contact form on my site recently? Summarize what each person asked for.
Show the most recent orders on my site, with status and total.

positive.prompt: Which sites do I have in Aglyn?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the sites in the connected test workspace by name, including Juniper Street Bakery, Juniper Street Cafe and Juniper Street Catering.

positive.prompt: Who filled in the contact form on the Juniper Street Bakery site recently? Summarize what each person asked for.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Juniper Street Bakery site, reads its recent Contact us entries and summarizes each sender and request, using only what the entries contain. It does not change their read state.

positive.description: Add a contact and a follow-up task
positive.prompt: Add Jordan Lee, jordan.lee@example.com, as a contact and create a task to call them on Friday.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks for approval before writing, then adds the contact (or reuses an existing contact with that email), creates a task due on Friday linked to the contact, and reports both.

positive.prompt: Which datasets do I have, and what fields does each one hold?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the datasets in the test workspace with each one’s field names, such as the Juniper Street Cafe menu and team datasets.

positive.prompt: Show the most recent orders on the Juniper Street Bakery site, with status and total.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the bakery’s most recent orders with order number, date, customer, status and total, and changes nothing.

negative.description: Refunds are not supported and must not be attempted
negative.prompt: Refund order 1064 to the customer’s card.

negative.description: Plan and billing changes are not supported
negative.prompt: Upgrade my Aglyn plan to Pro and add a new card.

negative.description: An unrelated request should not use the plugin
negative.prompt: What is the weather in Chicago tomorrow?

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. It can read a store's orders and mark an order shipped or delivered.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: sites, site content, contacts and CRM, form entries, orders, products, bookings and media.
